paragraphs: Yosef bar Chanin (asking Rabbi Abbahu): Shabbat 116a.
Rabbi Nachman bar Chanin: Bereshit Rabbah 41:7.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Shabbat 116a paragraph has Yosef bar Chanin asking Rabbi Abbahu, and the whole Midrash Rabbah TE Bereshit Rabbah 41:7 paragraph names Rabbi Nachman bar Chanin. These locally support the full titles and first question direction. The separate pointers do not establish one father, and no additional figures, teaching, or narrative is imported.
